questions.questionText: Which ray passes through the focal point of a convex lens before emerging parallel?
questions.imageCaption: Ray diagram of a convex lens
questions.explanation: A ray passing through the focal point of a convex lens emerges parallel to the principal axis.

questions.questionText: Why does dispersion occur in a prism?
questions.passageText: When white light passes through a prism, different colours bend by different amounts because the refractive index of glass depends on wavelength.
questions.imageCaption: Dispersion of white light through a prism

options.optionText: Because refractive index depends on wavelength

questions.explanation_question: White light contains multiple wavelengths. When it enters a prism, each wavelength bends differently.
questions.explanation_answer: Dispersion occurs because the refractive index of glass depends on wavelength.
questions.explanation: Dispersion occurs because refractive index varies with wavelength.

questions.questionText: What type of image is formed by a plane mirror?
questions.imageCaption: Image formation by a plane mirror
questions.explanation_question: White light contains multiple wavelengths. When it enters a prism, each wavelength bends differently.
questions.explanation_answer: Dispersion occurs because the refractive index of glass depends on wavelength.
questions.explanation: A plane mirror forms a virtual and erect image.

questions.questionText: Where is the principal focus of a concave mirror located?
questions.imageCaption: Ray diagram of a concave mirror
questions.explanation: The principal focus of a concave mirror lies in front of the mirror.

questions.questionText: What type of image is formed when an object is placed between F and 2F of a convex lens?
questions.imageCaption: Object between F and 2F of a convex lens
questions.explanation: The image is real, inverted and enlarged.
